_comment: Copy to <vault>/wiki/project-map.json. 'projects': allowed values of the project field on a session page, with display names, in index order. 'kinds': allowed values of the kind field. 'cwd': working directory -> project page for the session-start hook; the first project with a substring found in the lower-cased cwd wins. 'groups': transcript folder name (under ~/.claude/projects) -> storage group; first match wins; 'all' = every substring must appear; 'equals' = exact folder name. 'cwd_exclude': working directories that never get a project page injected, for example automated agent sandboxes whose path contains a project name.
